topic: Albanian law students protest for the right to take the state bar exam and other professional exams in Albanian (2026 Albanian student protests; resumed mass street protests in Skopje 2026-10-19/20 after a failed deal with the Justice Ministry)
scale: mass street protests in Skopje; around 400 law graduates from three universities; organizers claim over 10,000 participants in the second rally
quote1: Albanian law students in North Macedonia warned on Monday that would relaunch mass street protests, reiterating their staunch opposition to a government plan that mandates taking professional state examinations in a combination of both Macedonian and Albanian.
quote2: If their demand is not fully accepted, the students will organize protests again.
